recipes.title: Recipe library
recipes.description: Browse, favorite, filter by category, scale servings, and share recipes.

meals.title: Meal planner
meals.description: Schedule lunch and dinner by day, week, or month — or auto-plan a full week.

groceries.title: Shopping lists
groceries.description: Generate a grocery list from scheduled meals or selected recipes.

timers.title: Cooking timers
timers.description: Step timers with Live Activities on Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.

planning.title: Diet-aware planning
planning.description: Plan meals for balanced, vegetarian, vegan, or high-protein diets.

privacy.title: On your device
privacy.description: Your recipes and plans stay local. No account required.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.subtitle: Get started with CookGPT on iPhone or iPad.
installSteps: Download CookGPT from the App Store.
Open the app — sample recipes and a meal schedule are included.
Explore Recipes, Meals, Groceries, and Settings from the tab bar.
quickStartSteps: Browse recipes and tap one to see ingredients and steps.
Start a step timer — it appears on your Lock Screen while you cook.
Open Meals to schedule or auto-plan your week.
Generate a grocery list from your planned meals in Groceries.

features.recipes: Recipes — categories, favorites, sorting, sharing, and custom recipes
features.meals: Meals — day/week/month views, manual scheduling, and auto meal planning
features.groceries: Groceries — dynamic shopping lists from your meal plan
features.settings: Settings — theme, categories, units, breakfast planning, and data reset
